subject: Spell-check
author: hn6
body:
I don't think you can really complain about them taking the piss out of bad spelling. It's very easy to do a spell-check in this day and age and this should catch most of the errors that they are picking up on. It also never hurts to do a final read-through after the spell-check. This doesn't really apply for someone with dyslexia (is it just me or is the spelling of that word not the ultimate bad taste joke?) but the rest of us have no excuse. I know that an email is supposed to be somewhat throwaway but until they stop reading out every one we send them you have to assume that they are for public display and/or ridicule.

 

50 Hurtz

subject: A.W. Razzing
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
I’m with hn6 and Barcode on this one even though I did get razzed a little bit.  I don't get paid to spell correctly so I never bothered with it.  It’s my own fault for not spell checking.  After listening to the first 4 pod casts it was pretty obvious that they are going to read your e-mails letter for letter character for character and that Alex is a stickler as far as spelling goes.  Small price to pay to hear some of our questions answered which is more than a lot of designers/developers are doing.  They could just leave us in the dark.  Like hn6 was saying, if you send something in everyone’s going to hear it so give it a double check, its your own fault if you don't.  It was kind of shocking to hear the team treating their fans like that though.  I would have expected a little bit of leeway towards the people who were writing in to them but oh well.  Alex Ward was no worse than what Bootleg can dish out, I'd like to see those two race in a room sometime.  My moneys on Boot.  For anyone else that is thinking of entering in any questions for the pod cast I typed up this intro to use if you want...hopefully they can see the humor in it.

High everyone at Criterion games.  Eye am a huge fan.  Burnout is a reel fun game.  Wood ewe bee interested in answering a phew questions eye have?  Eye used spill chick too make shore their are know typos.....

 

 

" Ooh ooh ooh......VERTICAL.......sweeeeeeeeeeet! "
